h2: Handyman Canggu – One Visit for Doors, Locks & Small Repairs
intro: Canggu went from rice paddies to villa-lined streets in a few short years, and many homes still show the wear of being built fast. A Handyman Canggu call-out bundles sticking doors, cracked silicone, loose shelves and wobbly locks into a single trip so you're not juggling five different trades. Send photos on WhatsApp and get a straight answer before anyone picks up a drill.

sections.h3: Why a Handyman Canggu Visit Makes Sense Here
sections.text: Villas across Berawa and Batu Bolong rose quickly from former paddies, and the high groundwater table keeps pushing moisture into frames and seals. We regularly see doors that stick after a couple of rainy seasons, bathroom silicone peeling within months, and mosquito screens torn by wind off the surrounding fields. None of these are big jobs alone, but they pile up fast when you're managing a rental or living full-time here. One visit handles the lot.

sections.h3: What to Send on WhatsApp for a Quick Quote
sections.text: Snap a few photos in good light – the sticking hinge, the cracked seal, the wobbly shelf bracket – and drop them into our chat along with a one-line description of what's wrong. If it's a lock that won't turn or a curtain rail sagging under weight, note whether the frame is aluminium or wood so we bring the right screws and anchors. You'll get a rough quote based on those images; the final number depends on what we find once we're on site.

sections.h3: Rainy-Season Prep Before the Downpours Hit
sections.text: Walk your property each month with a notebook before the heavy rains arrive. Check that bathroom silicone hasn't gone fuzzy at the corners – re-siliconing now saves a leaky ceiling later. Make sure mosquito screens are fully seated; the wind off Echo Beach can rip them loose within weeks of the first storms. If your villa sits near Pererenan's old paddy channels, confirm the garden drain still flows freely after a downpour. Ten minutes of checking keeps small issues from becoming water damage.

We cover Berawa, Batu Bolong, Echo Beach, Pererenan, Babakan and Padonan, so a single outing can sort a sticking front door in one villa and re-hang shelves in another nearby unit. Villa managers often batch three or four small tasks – new locks, TV bracket tightening, furniture assembly for incoming guests – into one slot to save travel time. Send us the list with photos and we'll sequence the work so everything gets done before your next check-in.

faq.q: Can you handle both a plumbing drip and a sticking door in one trip?
faq.a: Yes – if the jobs sit close together we bundle them into a single visit. Send photos of everything on WhatsApp and we'll confirm what fits together before booking.

faq.q: Do I need to be home while you're working?
faq.a: For most small repairs like re-hanging shelves or swapping a lock, a caretaker or villa manager can let us in. Just make sure someone is available to hand over keys and point out the specific spots.

faq.q: How do I get a price without calling anyone?
faq.a: Message our WhatsApp number with clear photos and a short description; the quote depends on scope and materials, so we reply with a range based on what you send.
